input.quote: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: Sections 13.1–13.3 sit at the preferred position for the Services and paid-up Vendor Technology licences (Affiliates and contractors named, perpetual and irrevocable paid-up grant, transfer to Affiliate/successor, revocation only for material uncured breach after cure). The gap is Section 14.2: the licence to Deliverables — work product created specifically for us and paid for by us — is expressly revocable, non-transferable, limited to the Order Form term, and omits Affiliates and contractors. Section 10.1 preserves Deliverable rights only "according to their terms", so 14.2 governs and those rights simply lapse. That fails even the fallback (no successor transfer, no Affiliate coverage) and a revocable-at-will grant approaches walk-away territory. The redline conforms the Deliverable licence to Section 13 without disturbing Vendor's ownership position (addressed under the IP rule).

ops.oldText: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, reproduce, display, modify, and create derivative works from each Deliverable for Customer's business purposes, transferable to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24. Vendor shall not revoke or suspend that licence except as permitted by Section 13.3.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need the Deliverable licence to match the licence terms elsewhere in Section 13: perpetual and irrevocable, extending to our Affiliates and contractors, and transferable to a successor, since we pay for Deliverables created specifically for us. A licence that is revocable at Vendor's discretion and expires with the Order Form term leaves us unable to keep using work product we funded.
proposal.summary: Make the Deliverable licence perpetual, irrevocable, Affiliate/contractor-wide and successor-transferable.
